🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; mixed leadership with Energy, Utilities and Industrials driving 1W gains while Technology and Communication pressured. Confirmation: low sector breadth and large-cap tech divergence (multiple mega-caps showing 1W vs 1M mismatches) support a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +10.48%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials solid: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -9.83% | 1M: +7.47%) CORRECTION. Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary pressured: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5: Utilities, Industrials, Materials).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -10.44% | 1M: +4.01%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in large-cap tech and select growth names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W momentum: VST (1W: +10.76%), LMT (1W: +10.72%), CEG (1W: +9.46%). Major divergence present: several mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, META, GOOGL) show 1W vs 1M mismatches → MAJOR DIVERGENCE, watch for trend breaks and avoid regime overconfidence.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is mixed to weak; sector 1W: -3.49% with large-cap dispersion. NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND, while GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -9.83% | 1M: +7.47%) CORRECTION — internal rotation and headline-driven selling.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are mixed: JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND but sector 1W: -1.70% overall; V (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +8.83%) CORRECTION show short-term pullbacks despite 1M strength. Expect selective strength among large banks and payment processors if macro stays stable.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows selective strength: JNJ (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: -0.77% but 1M positive — defensive tone with some pockets outperforming.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and Industrials exposure (XOM, CVX, LMT, HON) and Utilities for tactical strength; reduce exposure to the weakest large-cap tech names showing CORRECTION/B ELOW TREND (GOOGL, ADBE, TSLA). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth given sector leadership and low breadth.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: RTX (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed (+85); VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND — continued utility bid. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — watch for further downside on capex concerns; TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND — tail risk and volatility ahead.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: sector positive; XOM, CVX ABOVE TREND) and Industrials (LMT, HON ABOVE TREND) for continuation. BEARISH: Technology and Communication (sector 1W negative) — monitor for further dispersion and headline-driven moves.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XOM 1W strength to test recent highs (monitor continuation above near-term resistance); NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND — watch for support on small pullbacks; GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — failing to reclaim lower resistance would signal further downside.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
RTX (+85): RTX (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND — Q2 beat and raised outlook confirming price action. CMCSA (+75): CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND — positive Peacock profit headline but price diverging (distribution). NOW (+80): NOW (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND — upgraded outlook but share price not confirming, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (-35): GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines on AI capex align with sharp price weakness. (Other negative sentiment names flagged in news include ORCL (-50) and INTU (-50); monitor those for cross-checks to price action).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy, Utilities and Industrials leadership amid weak overall breadth. XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large-cap tech (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META showing 1W vs 1M conflicts) and mixed sentiment headlines — watch for trend confirmation before redeploying cyclicals into growth.
